confirm.title: Approve tablet
confirm.description:
{name} wants to join Njörun.

The tablet shows a six-digit code. Approve it only if that code is **{code}**.

abort.tablet_approved: The tablet is approved. It appears under Devices in a few seconds; change its settings on its device page.
abort.tablet_not_waiting: The tablet is no longer waiting. Make sure it is switched on and can reach Home Assistant; it appears here again within a minute.
abort.approval_failed: The tablet could not be approved. Reload Njörun and try again from the Discovered card.

init.title: Manage Njörun
init.description: Profiles hold settings that several tablets share ({profiles} now). Settings of a single tablet are on its device page.

menu_options.edit_profile: Change the settings a profile gives its tablets
menu_options.add_profile: Create a profile for tablets that share settings
menu_options.delete_profile: Delete a profile no tablet uses
menu_options.remote_logging: Send the tablets' log to Grafana Loki, or switch that off

remote_logging.title: Remote logging
remote_logging.description: Every tablet sends its log records to this Grafana Loki server, including the log before an unclean restart. Enter the server address, for example `https://loki.example.org`. Leave empty to switch it off. Tokens, Wi-Fi passwords and codes are removed before anything is sent.

error.invalid_configuration: The operation or settings are invalid. Refresh the integration and try again.
error.invalid_log_sink: Enter an http or https address without user name, password or parameters, for example https://loki.example.org.

capabilities_conflict.title: Capabilities of {tablet} conflict with its settings
capabilities_conflict.description: The tablet {tablet} reports capabilities that its current settings do not fit ({reason}). Home Assistant keeps the capabilities it stored. Change the conflicting setting; the tablet reports again when it reconnects.

install_firmware.name: Install firmware
install_firmware.description: Installs a firmware release on a tablet. Without a version the newest release of the tablet's update channel is installed. A release older than the running one is installed only with the downgrade flag.

version.name: Version
version.description: A release version such as 0.2.0. Empty for the newest of the channel.

allow_downgrade.name: Allow downgrade
allow_downgrade.description: Install a version older than the running one.
